visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual Odesa cathedral with cream/white classical facades, low gray cruciform roofs, large eastern dome on an arched-window drum and two smaller western domes. The tall western tower has a closed lower windowed stage, truly open upper arched belfry, four clock faces, bronze-brown bulb and tall needle with restrained gold finial/cross. Four open columned porticoes, closed wood entries, raised podiums, stairs, sparse mullions, pilasters and cornices establish the exterior. Corrected inward dome/needle winding, closed the missing low-wing roof caps, removed a window overlapping the west wood door and lowered the common basement base from 3.53m to 0.5m. The 3m raised entry plane remains. Detailed facade/drum apertures have closed glass backing; porch and upper belfry gaps are open. No full interiors, sculpture, icons or lettering.
